title: Towel Shelf 23-Inch Three Tier Hotel Style Drying Rack, Solid Brass | Satin Brass | Towel Shelves | Allied Brass
description:
Create organized storage for clean towels while keeping damp linens off the counter in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass. This wall-mounted towel shelf is a three tier hotel-style train rack with a built-in drying rack—ideal when you want a towel rack and towel holder in one.

Highlights:
- Satin Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Built for lasting use: solid brass construction / brass construction
- Designed for coordinated decorating: matches the towel shelves collection and transitional bathroom hardware
- Works across styles: a versatile choice for versatile bath accessories in guest bathrooms and primary baths

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging towel shelf (also used as a towel rack or towel holder)
- Dimensions: 23 in (L) x 10 in (H) x 9 in (W)
- Shipping weight: 7 lbs
- Installation: mounting hardware included; some assembly required
- Country of assembly: Assembled in the USA
